name: Thermal day
story: The air settles and the sun goes to work: a deep mixed layer under a lid at 1900 m, a cumulus capping every thermal, strong climbs for those who look for them. Bumpy below the cloud after 13:00.
forecast: Warm and fair. Cumulus from 11:00, base rising to 1800 m, tops at the inversion near 1900 m. Wind southwest 6 kt. Moderate thermal turbulence 13:00-17:00 below 1800 m. Clear, mild night.
